title: Redlamp sidecar (.redlamp), format 3: edit.json
description: The edit.json of a .redlamp sidecar package. A history session file (history/<id>.json) validates against #/$defs/historyFile. Objects without additionalProperties: false are where Redlamp keeps fields it doesn't know and writes them back unchanged. See sidecar-format.md.

format.description: The file type. Redlamp always writes it but doesn't check it.

snapshots.description: Named versions of the edit, oldest first.

modified.description: When the edit was last saved. The newest edit wins when conflicting copies merge.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

uuid.description: A UUID. Redlamp writes upper case and reads either case.

date.description: ISO 8601 with a time zone. Redlamp writes whole seconds in UTC, as 2026-10-03T12:59:01Z.

imagePoint.description: A point in the photo as its EXIF orientation shows it, before crop, Transform and lens correction: (0, 0) is the top left and (1, 1) the bottom right. Points may lie outside 0...1.

recipe.description: The edit. Every key is optional; a missing key means its default.

version.description: Format version: the file's syntax, 3 here. Older versions are read and migrated; a newer one makes the sidecar read-only.

processVersion.description: The rendering behavior the edit was made with (see sidecar-format.md). A newer one makes the sidecar read-only.

profile.description: Format 1's name for baseLook, read when baseLook is missing. Never written.

whiteBalance.description: The white balance popup. The values it resolved to are wb.temperature and wb.tint.

pointCurve.description: The point curve, in increasing x. Written only when it isn't the straight line.

pointColor.description: Point Color's swatches, applied right after the Color Mixer, each changing the colours near its own. Written only when there is one.

masks.description: Local adjustments, applied in order on top of the global edit.

spots.description: Remove, Heal and Clone spots, applied in order before everything else.

panelsOff.description: The Develop panels switched off, in panel order: each renders as though its settings left the photo alone, and keeps them. Written only when a panel is off. A name a newer Redlamp wrote is kept.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

values.description: Global parameters by key, each written only when it differs from its default. Readers clamp a value to its range. Keys of local, mask and spot parameters don't belong here and are dropped.

wb.temperature.description: White balance Temp, in kelvin. With whiteBalance asShot a raw renders with the camera's white balance, and this holds the as-shot value for display.

wb.shift.red.description: White balance fine-tuning on the red axis, on top of Temp and Tint.

wb.shift.blue.description: White balance fine-tuning on the blue axis, on top of Temp and Tint.

basic.dynamicRange.description: Highlight headroom in percent, like a camera's DR setting: 100, 200 or 400.

toneCurve.split.shadows.description: Parametric curve: where Shadows end and Darks begin, in percent of the input range.

toneCurve.split.midtones.description: Parametric curve: where Darks end and Lights begin, in percent of the input range.

toneCurve.split.highlights.description: Parametric curve: where Lights end and Highlights begin, in percent of the input range.

grading.shadows.hue.description: Color grading, Shadows: hue, in degrees.

grading.midtones.hue.description: Color grading, Midtones: hue, in degrees.

grading.highlights.hue.description: Color grading, Highlights: hue, in degrees.

grading.global.hue.description: Color grading, Global: hue, in degrees.

lens.profile.description: Enable Profile Corrections, a switch: 1 applies the lens correction the photo's file carries (process 5 and later; Fujifilm's from process 6), 0 doesn't.

lens.profileDistortion.description: The profile's distortion correction, in percent.

lens.profileVignetting.description: The profile's vignetting correction, in percent.

lens.removeChromaticAberration.description: Remove Chromatic Aberration, a switch: 1 corrects lateral color fringes, from the profile or measured; 0 doesn't.

lens.defringePurpleHueLow.description: Defringe: the low end of the purple hue range.

lens.defringePurpleHueHigh.description: Defringe: the high end of the purple hue range.

lens.defringeGreenHueLow.description: Defringe: the low end of the green hue range.

lens.defringeGreenHueHigh.description: Defringe: the high end of the green hue range.

crop.angle.description: The crop's angle (Straighten), in degrees; positive turns the photo clockwise.

transform.vertical.description: Transform: Vertical perspective; negative widens the top.

transform.horizontal.description: Transform: Horizontal perspective; negative widens the left side.

transform.offsetX.description: Transform: X Offset, as a share of the frame's half width.

transform.offsetY.description: Transform: Y Offset, as a share of the frame's half height.

effects.grain.color.description: Grain: how much the grain differs between the dye layers; 0 is monochrome grain.

effects.frame.style.description: Frame style, by number: 0 none, 1 keyline, 2 print border, 3 35 mm rebate, 4 slide mount. The numbers never change.

effects.colorChrome.description: Color Chrome: deepens highly saturated colors.

effects.colorChromeBlue.description: Color Chrome FX Blue: the same, for blues only.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter a newer Redlamp added: kept and written back unchanged.

curvePoint.description: A point of the point curve, display-referred, input x to output y.

baseLookReference.description: The Base Look the edit renders with (Lightroom's profile), as in the .redrecipe format.

id.description: redlamp/base/... for built-in looks, local/... for looks made or imported on this Mac. Format 1's ids (redlamp.vivid) are read as redlamp/base/vivid.

name.description: The look's name, for display. Defaults to the built-in look's name, or else the id.

amount.description: Strength in percent; 100 is the look as designed.

contentHash.description: Pins the exact look table, for looks that have one.

exposureAnchor.description: Under Redlamp Reproduction (redlamp/base/reproduction), where the photo's camera puts a metered 18% grey: the stops added to Exposure, in place of a DNG's BaselineExposure, that take it to scene 0.18. Always the photo's own camera's, never copied from another photo; written only with that look. Without one, the look renders with the typical anchor, 1.03.

source.description: target: measured with Calibrate from Target. typical: the camera has no calibration. A value a newer Redlamp wrote is kept.

camera.description: The camera it belongs to: the model the file states, after its make unless the model names it.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

appliedRecipe.description: The .redrecipe the edit was last built from. Provenance only: rendering never reads it.

amount.description: The recipe's Amount when it was applied, in percent.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

cropRect.description: The crop, in the straightened frame: the oriented, transformed photo turned by crop.angle. The full frame is 0...1 on both axes. Written only when it isn't the full frame.

orientation.description: The user's rotation and flip, after the camera's EXIF orientation. Written only when it isn't the identity.

mirrored.description: Mirrored left to right before turning.

maskLayer.description: A local adjustment: a mask built from components, and its own adjustments.

components.description: Combined in order, each with the coverage of those before it.

inverted.description: The whole mask inverted, once its components have combined. Written only when true.

amount.description: Scales every adjustment of the mask, in percent.

detail.description: Above 0 keeps only textured areas of the mask, below 0 only flat ones. Written only when it isn't 0.

curves.description: The mask's Curves: point curves on the display-referred values the global point curve works on, the RGB curve on every channel and then each channel's own, applied as far as the mask covers and scaled by its amount. Each is written only when it isn't straight, and curves isn't written when none is.

additionalProperties.description: A curve a newer Redlamp added: kept and written back unchanged.

pointColor.description: The mask's own Point Color swatches, after the edit's, as far as the mask covers and scaled by its amount. Written only when there is one.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

localAdjustments.description: The mask's adjustments, each written only when it isn't 0. Readers clamp a value to its range, and keep keys they don't know and write them back unchanged.

local.temperature.description: Temp, relative to the global white balance.

local.tint.description: Tint, relative to the global white balance.

local.halation.description: Halation where the mask covers; the size stays global.

local.bloom.description: Bloom where the mask covers; the size stays global.

local.color.hue.description: The Color swatch's hue, as on a color wheel (0 is red).

local.color.saturation.description: The Color swatch's strength: how much it tints what the mask covers; 0 for no tint.

additionalProperties.description: A local adjustment a newer Redlamp added: kept and written back unchanged.

operation.description: How the component combines with the components before it.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

maskShape.description: Exactly one key, the component's kind, holding its parameters under _0. A kind Redlamp doesn't know renders nothing and is written back unchanged.

ai.description: A mask computed by a model: Subject, Sky, Background, Objects, People or Landscape.

additionalProperties.description: A component kind written by a newer Redlamp: renders nothing, kept and written back unchanged.

linearMask.description: Full effect at start, fading to none at end.

radialMask.description: An ellipse with a feathered edge, full effect inside.

radiusX.description: A fraction of the image height.

radiusY.description: A fraction of the image height.

brushMask.description: Painted strokes, in order; erase strokes take coverage away from earlier ones.

brushStroke.description: One stroke: dabs along points, each a soft disc.

pressures.description: Pen pressure at each point; empty when the input had none (full pressure).

size.description: The brush radius, as a fraction of the image height.

feather.description: The share of the radius that fades out.

density.description: The most coverage the stroke can reach.

erase.description: Removes coverage instead of adding it.

autoMask.description: Keeps each dab to colors like the one under its center.

luminanceRangeMask.description: Full coverage for lightness (OKLab L x 100 of the photo with its global edit) between lower and upper, fading to none over the feathers.

samplePoint.description: Where the eyedropper sampled, for its pin. Not used for rendering.

colorRangeMask.description: Colors like any of the samples, read from the photo with its global edit at every render.

refine.description: How far from the samples a color may be and still be selected.

pointColorSwatch.description: One of Point Color's swatches: a colour, the range of colours around it that it selects, and what it does to them.

color.description: The colour the swatch selects around: picked on the photo or carried by a preset, in OKLCh; or, on a mask only, "mask": the colour typical of what the mask covers, worked out for each photo.

picked.description: Where the colour was picked, when it was.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

oklch.description: A colour in OKLCh, as the colour controls see it after the tone curve.

lightness.description: OKLab lightness: 0 is black and 1 white on screen.

pointColorValues.description: A swatch's settings, each written only when it isn't its default. Readers clamp a value to its range, and keep keys they don't know and write them back unchanged.

pointColor.shift.hue.description: Hue Shift: turns the selected colours' hue.

pointColor.uniformity.hue.description: Hue Uniformity: above 0 the selected colours' hue moves towards the swatch's, below 0 away from it.

pointColor.uniformity.saturation.description: Saturation Uniformity, the same on chroma.

pointColor.uniformity.luminance.description: Luminance Uniformity, the same on lightness.

pointColor.range.hue.description: Hue Range: how far in hue a colour may be from the swatch's and still be selected.

pointColor.range.saturation.description: Saturation Range, the same in chroma.

pointColor.range.luminance.description: Luminance Range, the same in lightness.

pointColor.range.smoothness.description: Smoothness: how gradually the selection fades out at the range's edge.

additionalProperties.description: A setting a newer Redlamp added: kept and written back unchanged.

radius.description: The sampled disc's radius, as a fraction of the image height; 0 samples a small spot.

maskBitmap.description: An 8-bit grayscale PNG coverage map in the photo's oriented frame, stored as masks/<sha256>.png.

sha256.description: The PNG's hash, and its file name in the package's masks folder.

aiMask.description: A mask computed by a model and kept as a bitmap, so it renders the same everywhere and changes only when the user updates it.

kind.description: What the mask is of; depthRange for a depth map.

provider.description: What computed it, for example apple.vision.foreground.

revision.description: The provider's request or model revision.

osBuild.description: The macOS build, for system models that change with the OS.

instance.description: Which person or object, when the provider found several.

part.description: A part of a person (People) or a Landscape class.

prompts.description: Points the user clicked to guide the model.

excludedPrompts.description: Points the user clicked to leave out.

box.description: For Objects, the box dragged around the thing, or the one Find found it in, in the oriented frame, 0...1. Updating the mask asks the model with it again.

feather.description: Softens the mask's edge. Written only when it isn't 0.

edge.description: Moves the mask's edge out (above 0) or in (below 0). Written only when it isn't 0.

analysisHash.description: A hash of the render the model saw.

bitmap.description: The model's mask, with the refinements applied.

refinements.description: Refine Edge strokes, in order, kept so updating the mask can apply them again.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

depthRangeMask.description: Full coverage for depths between lower and upper (0 farthest, 100 nearest), fading over the feathers.

depth.description: The depth map; near is white.

maskID.description: The id of another mask of the edit. Its own references are ignored.

retouchSpot.description: A Remove, Heal or Clone spot. These types are still evolving.

mode.description: Remove fills from the photo around the spot; Heal copies source's texture matched to the spot's surroundings; Clone copies source as it is. Readers treat any other value as heal.

source.description: Where Heal and Clone copy from. Remove doesn't use it and writes center.

stroke.description: A brushed spot's points after its first (center), each relative to center. Written only for a brushed spot.

region.description: A picked person or object: the spot is this mask grown by radius, instead of a circle or stroke.

radius.description: A fraction of the image height: the circle's or brush's radius, or how far a region grows.

feather.description: The share of the radius that fades out.

fill.description: A Remove spot's fill made by a generative model, used instead of filling it from the photo.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

generatedFill.description: A Remove spot's fill made by a generative model (RM-10), kept so it renders the same everywhere.

bitmap.description: A 16-bit RGB PNG in the package's masks folder: the photo's camera RGB, white balanced as shot and linear, divided by peak and square-rooted.

peak.description: The scale the bitmap's values are stored at.

box.description: Where the bitmap goes, in the photo's full-size pixels before its orientation.

photoSize.description: The photo's full size before its orientation, as the fill was made for it. A reader whose decode of the photo is another size fills the spot from the photo instead.

model.description: The model's manifest id, for example flux2-klein-4b-fill.

prompt.description: The name of the prompt it was made with, from those the model carries.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

snapshot.description: A named version of the edit.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

metadata.description: Rating, flag, color label, mark, the photo's original name, its keywords, title, caption, creator, copyright and location, and the collections and stack it's in. Written only when one is set.

customLabel.description: A label named otherwise than the five colors, as Urgent. Never in label, which older builds can't read with another value; where both are there, label is the photo's label.

mark.description: In the quick collection. Written only when true.

originalName.description: The photo's file name before Redlamp first renamed it, as IMG_1234.CR3. Written the first time Redlamp renames the photo, and kept through every rename and move after that.

keywords.description: The photo's keywords, each its full path from the top of the keyword list with / between levels, as Places/Portugal/Lisbon. A / inside a keyword is written %2F and a % as %25. An empty list means no keywords; without the key, the keywords embedded in the photo and in other apps' .xmp are its keywords.

title.description: IPTC Core's Title. Empty means none; without the key, the title embedded in the photo or in other apps' .xmp is its title.

caption.description: IPTC Core's Description. Empty means none; without the key, other apps' stands.

creator.description: IPTC Core's Creator, several names separated by semicolons. Empty means none; without the key, other apps' stands.

copyright.description: IPTC Core's Copyright Notice. Empty means none; without the key, other apps' stands.

collections.description: The collections the photo is in, each by its path from the top of the collection list, written as keywords' paths are. Written only when there are some.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

location.description: Where the photo was taken, in IPTC Core's fields, each written only when set. An empty object means nowhere; without the key, other apps' location stands.

sublocation.description: A place within the city: a district, a street, a building.

countryCode.description: The country's ISO 3166 code, as PT.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

stack.description: The photo's place in a stack the user made: photos with one id are one stack wherever they are, and a photo whose id no other photo has stands alone, in no burst.

top.description: Shown for its stack: the one id names, or without an id the burst it's in. Written only when true.

additionalProperties.description: Fields written by a newer Redlamp: kept and written back unchanged.

historyFile.description: A history session file, history/<id>.json: the first step's whole edit, then each later step as a JSON Patch from the one before.

version.description: The history format version. Redlamp skips a file with a newer one, and never removes it.

id.description: The session's id, and the file's name.

bitmaps.description: Every mask bitmap the steps use, sorted, so the package keeps them without reading every step.

title.description: What the History panel shows, for example Exposure.

before.description: The one value the step changed, as it was, for example +0.50.

recipe.description: The whole edit; the first step has it.

patch.description: The change from the step before. A step with neither recipe nor patch leaves the edit as it was.

historyAction.description: The kind of step, for its icon: a plain name, adjustment:<parameter key>, or mask:<mask kind>. Readers treat an action they don't know as edit.

patchOperation.description: An RFC 6902 JSON Patch operation; Redlamp writes add, remove and replace.

jsonPointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the edit; - as the last token appends to an array.
